issue.body:
PR #35759: [ROCm] Remove ConvAlgorithmPicker

Imported from GitHub PR https://github.com/openxla/xla/pull/35759

📝 Summary of Changes
Default to MIOpen immediate mode allowing regular convolution to work w/o autotuning and any workarounds in convolution_thunk. Remove fallback path for RocmFusedConvRunner and revert fused convs back to regular ones if no algorithm has been found during the autotuning. Implement miopen autotuning backend and remove ConvAlgorithmPicker as rocm was its sole user.

🎯 Justification
Solves one TODO on b/407494793

🚀 Kind of Contribution
♻️ Cleanup

🧪 Unit Tests:
Added //xla/service/gpu/transforms:cudnn_fused_conv_rewriter_autotune_disabled_test to stress out
fused conv decomposing path.

Copybara import of the project:
